summary: Comprehensive testing of Survey/Feedback Application MVP completed. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate). Frontend authentication and core functionality tested successfully. Analytics with Chart.js integration verified.

integration_issues.issue: JWT tokens appear to expire quickly, causing frequent redirects to login page during extended testing sessions
integration_issues.workaround: Manual token setting in localStorage works for testing

passed_tests: User Registration - Successfully creates account with email, password, full name
User Login - Login with registered credentials works correctly
JWT Authentication - Protected routes properly require authentication
Backend API - All 13 API endpoints tested with 100% success rate
Survey Creation API - Creates surveys with multiple question types
Response Submission API - Submits and stores survey responses
Analytics API - Generates analytics data with question breakdowns
Public Survey Access - Anonymous users can access and fill surveys
Dashboard UI - Professional design loads correctly with proper layout
Analytics Dashboard - Chart.js charts render correctly (doughnut and bar charts)
Real-time Data - Response counts and analytics update correctly
Design Guidelines - Swiss high-contrast aesthetic properly implemented
Navigation - Sidebar navigation and routing work correctly
Form Validation - Survey creation form validates inputs properly
action_item_for_main_agent: Investigate JWT token expiration settings. Consider increasing token lifetime or implementing refresh token mechanism to improve user experience during extended sessions.
